baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins water to the passive descriptor masqub, poured or running out.
baseline_models.mechanism: The water is presented as an active, continuing outflow rather than a static stored body.

activation_trace.role: Known water supplies the literal substance around which the reading is built.
Pouring, spilling, and ground-running turn the substance into visible movement.
The branch image of persistence makes the outflow durative rather than momentary.

changed_reading.before: A generic mention of pleasant water.
changed_reading.after: Water continually released into view and kept in effortless motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both ma and masqub carry focus-internal branches of delivering water by pouring and of a place made for pouring or watering.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can depict directed delivery into a receiving place, giving the water an irrigating function rather than only scenic value.

activation_trace.role: Conveying water by watering or pouring supplies the delivery function.
A watering or pouring station supplies a destination and spatial organization for that delivery.

changed_reading.after: Water deliberately conveyed and poured where it can sustain a living setting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Removal of thorns, a tree, and orderly stacking revise the focus-only irrigation model into a managed horticultural system: the poured water services growth that has been made safe, accessible, and ordered.

activation_trace.role: Delivered irrigation water is the focus anchor and proposed input to the cultivated system.
Pouring and ground-running provide the movement by which water reaches the setting.
Removing thorns and breaking their sharpness contributes active hazard removal to the garden's management.
The tree image supplies vegetation that can receive the focus water.
Joining things in ordered arrangement makes the watered abundance structured rather than wild.

structural_cues: The focus water follows two vegetation lines whose modifiers describe removal and arrangement.
The repeated noun-plus-participle catalogue presents these amenities as coordinated parts of one setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered water, vegetation, de-thorning, and ordered accumulation; I supply the causal arrow from irrigation to managed growth. A live alternative is that these are parallel amenities with no hydraulic dependence.

changed_reading.before: Water deliberately delivered to an unspecified place.
changed_reading.after: The circulating input of an intentionally tended and spatially ordered orchard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sheltering shade and an extension branch explicitly describing water filled and supplied by other water convert pouring into a protected, self-replenishing circulation.

activation_trace.role: Appearing and abundant water supplies the volume maintained by the context mechanism.
Persistence anchors the claim that the pouring does not collapse into a single event.
The shade's shelter supplies a protected and cooling envelope for the adjacent flow.
Water that flows, fills, and is extended by further water supplies the replenishment mechanism directly.

structural_cues: Extended shade immediately precedes poured water in two parallel coordinated phrases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shelter, extension, replenished flowing water, and persistent pouring; I infer that shade and inflow cooperate as a stable microclimate. They may instead be independent neighboring comforts.

changed_reading.before: A continuous but otherwise unsupported outflow.
changed_reading.after: A shaded circulation whose outgoing water is continually replaced by connected inflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: A blessed companion-group frames the catalogue, while abundant fruit is neither ended nor withheld; by adjacency, the poured water becomes common provision characterized by temporal continuity and unobstructed access.

activation_trace.role: Persistent pouring anchors the temporal side of uninterrupted water provision.
Blessing characterizes the recipient frame and recasts the water as beneficent provision.
Pleasant fruit supplies the neighboring provision to which non-cessation and non-withholding directly attach.
Numerical growth contributes abundance rather than bare availability.
The negated image of ending or disappearance supplies temporal non-cessation.
The negated withholding hand supplies the social condition of access without discretionary refusal.
Companionship closes the catalogue around a collective receiver rather than a solitary owner.

structural_cues: The same recipient designation appears at 56:27 and 56:38, enclosing the amenity sequence.
The feminine negations in 56:33 directly describe fruit, not the grammatically masculine water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective frame, persistent pouring, abundance, and fruit explicitly neither ending nor withheld; I extend that availability logic analogically to the adjacent water. The live alternative confines both negations to fruit and leaves water merely flowing.

changed_reading.after: A shared supply that keeps arriving and is not subject to exhaustion or gatekeeping, by analogy with the adjacent fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's branch of reproductive water is activated by the following creation, transformation, and virginity cluster, allowing the poured water to carry a secondary image of generative potential.

activation_trace.role: Male reproductive water placed in the womb supplies the focus-internal generative material.
Outpouring provides the motion that lets the reproductive-water branch resonate with masqub.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the explicit creation frame.
Conception and growth of pregnancy sharpen the reproductive rather than merely artisanal sense of creation.
Transformation into a state supplies the result side of the generative process.
Virginity and untouchedness make reproductive potential salient while also limiting a literalized reading.

structural_cues: The catalogue moves from water and furnishings into an emphatic creation-and-making sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive water as a focus branch and then creation, pregnancy, transformation, and virginity images; I infer a generative echo across the transition. The materially live alternative is ordinary landscape water followed by an unrelated act of creation.

changed_reading.before: Only environmental water poured through a garden.
changed_reading.after: Environmental water that also faintly figures an outpoured principle of renewed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of restoring irrigation to straight flow, paired with equality, changes masqub from uncontrolled spilling into regulated distribution delivered evenly across the setting.

activation_trace.role: Water conveyed for irrigation supplies the material whose distribution is being reimagined.
Pouring and ground-running supply the flow that can be straightened and apportioned.
Irrigation restored to straightness after irregularity supplies explicit hydraulic regulation.
Equality in age and companionship is transferred cautiously into an image of even distribution.

structural_cues: The two trigger words form a compact paired description in 56:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a literal irrigation-straightening branch and a paired equality branch; I supply the cross-domain arrow from human equality to hydraulic apportionment. The alternative keeps equality solely among the described persons and leaves the water unregulated.

changed_reading.before: Water spilling freely wherever gravity takes it.
changed_reading.after: A corrected irrigation flow distributed with designed regularity and evenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathered groups from the first and later populations place persistent pouring across successive cohorts, making the water a repeatable provision rather than a single generation's allotment.

activation_trace.role: Persistence supplies the temporal capacity for the water to remain available across cohorts.
A gathered group supplies the first collective receiver.
Beginning and precedence establish the early temporal pole.
The alternate mapped root's one-after-another sequence supplies succession between recipient groups.
The repeated gathered-group image supplies the later collective receiver in parallel form.
Laterness supplies the second temporal pole reached by the continuous provision.

structural_cues: 56:39 and 56:40 repeat the same group construction while switching from first to later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent pouring and parallel gathered groups at early and later poles; I infer continuity of provision across their succession. The alternative is that the cohort labels count recipients without changing the water's temporal profile.

changed_reading.before: Continuous water within one local scene.
changed_reading.after: Provision whose continuity spans gathered recipients across successive temporal cohorts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from liquid into textile imagery; it remains anchored in the focus branch that names a thin cloth through resemblance to poured water and is activated by adjacent raised bedding. Downstream prose should render it only as an as-if sensory analogy, never as a claim that the water is literally fabric.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sk-b descriptor itself includes a branch in which a fine cloth resembles the pouring of water.

activation_trace.role: A thin garment likened to poured water supplies the focus-internal image of a fine flowing sheet.
Bedding and spread furnishings activate the textile side of the focus descriptor.
Elevation gives the imagined water-sheet a lifted or draped spatial profile.

changed_reading.before: Water perceived chiefly as volume and current.
changed_reading.after: Water also perceived, by contained analogy, as a fine continuous sheet unfurled beside raised furnishings.

strongest_changes: The extended-shade sequence turns pouring into a protected flow replenished by connected water.
The enclosing companion-group and the fruit's non-cessation and non-withholding recast water as common, durable, unobstructed provision.
The creation cluster activates the focus root's reproductive-water branch, while the irrigation-straightening branch activates regulated and even distribution.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic activations were unusually concrete cross-links already present in the packet: m-d-d explicitly describes water replenished by water, ar-b explicitly describes corrected irrigation, and focus branches preserve both generative water and cloth-like pouring.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic links among coordinated catalogue items are reader-supplied causal arrows; the items can remain independent amenities.
Non-cessation and non-withholding grammatically describe fruit, so their extension to water is analogical rather than syntactic.
The generative, egalitarian-hydraulic, and textile readings are branch-valid exploratory resonances, not claims about the focus phrase's primary denotation.
